context.transcript:
Hi everyone and welcome to Baking Matters, the show where famous cooks share their delicious recipes with us.
Before we get started with today's program, don't forget to sign up for our newsletter.
You can sign up on our website and it will be delivered right to your inbox.
And now... for today's show, we have a cake designing lesson led by expert baker Heather Silva.
Heather has placed first in the Havenville Baking Competition three years in a row.
And just this month, she published her first book titled Heather's Cake Designing Tips.
Look for it at your local bookstore.
Now grab your apron. and let's get baking.
context.transcript_translation:
大家好，欢迎收看《烘焙事宜》，这是一个著名厨师与我们分享美味食谱的节目。
在我们开始今天的节目之前，别忘了订阅我们的电子报。
你可以在我们的网站上订阅，它会直接发送到你的收件箱。
现在...对于今天的节目，我们有专家烘焙师 Heather Silva 主讲的蛋糕设计课程。
Heather 三年连续获得了 Havenville 烘焙大赛的第一名。
而且就在本月，她出版了她的第一本书，书名为《Heather's Cake Designing Tips》。
请在您当地的书店寻找它。
现在拿起你的围裙，让我们开始烘焙吧。
